test_case_name: Accept Cookies on Research Department Page via Parent Navigation

intents.intent: Click 'Gruppo' link on the parent page to navigate to the Research Department site
Click 'ACCONSENTO' link on the child page to accept cookies
And then check that the cookie banner is dismissed on the Research Department page

test_case_name: Access Cookie Options on Research Department Page via Parent Navigation

intents.intent: Click 'Gruppo' link on the parent page to navigate to the Research Department site
Click 'PIÙ OPZIONI' link on the child page to view cookie options
And then check that the cookie options page or modal is displayed

test_case_name: Close Cookie Banner on Research Department Page via Parent Navigation

intents.intent: Click 'Gruppo' link on the parent page to navigate to the Research Department site
Click the button with id 'js-cookie-banner-close' on the child page to close the cookie banner
And then check that the cookie banner is no longer visible on the Research Department page

test_case_name: Perform Search on Research Department Page via Parent Navigation

intents.intent: Click 'Gruppo' link on the parent page to navigate to the Research Department site
Click the button with class 'header-navbar-btn-search' and data-name 'search-open' on the child page to open the search bar
Type $name into the input with placeholder 'Cerca' on the child page
Click the button with class 'btn-search' and data-name 'search-button' on the child page to submit the search
And then check that the search results are displayed according to the query
